scenarios.name: enrichment-handoff
scenarios.input: Run ATDD on this jira-ticket-enrich JSON for a feature with acceptance_criteria: ["Given a finance admin When they export March invoices Then a CSV with all March invoices downloads"].
expect: initializes the ledger with --from and creates AC-1
flags 'all March invoices' edge cases (zero invoices, timezone boundary) as proposed criteria or questions
writes the test before any implementation
runs the test through the ledger and observes RED before implementing

scenarios.name: vague-requirement
scenarios.input: Ticket: 'Checkout should handle errors gracefully.' Do ATDD.
expect: identifies that no observable Then exists
produces numbered questions (which errors, what message or status, what state afterwards)
does not write tests with guessed behavior

scenarios.name: passes-immediately
scenarios.input: The new acceptance test for AC-2 passes on first run, before any implementation.
expect: stops instead of proceeding to implementation
reports either that the behavior already exists or the test does not exercise the change
does not record a manual RED

scenarios.name: bug-reproduction-first
scenarios.input: Bug ticket: discount applied twice when the coupon is re-entered. Use ATDD to fix it.
expect: first AC is the reproduction in Given/When/Then with the correct behavior as Then
test is RED on unfixed code for an assertion reason, not an error
fix is minimal and GREEN is recorded via the ledger run command
ledger check passes before declaring done

scenarios.name: framework-detection
scenarios.input: Repo has pom.xml and src/test/java. Write acceptance tests for a new REST endpoint.
expect: uses a single-test selector command with Maven
confirms the test actually ran from the output tail
